# 4. Read In Raw Counts, Prep Data
```{r READ-COUNTS, message=FALSE}
#------------------------ LOAD GENOME ALIGNMENT FILES ------------------------#
featcount  <- read_tsv("./Data_Repository/Log2ABA.featcount.txt", skip = 1)
count_cols <- colnames(featcount)[7:ncol(featcount)] # backup OG names except first 7 col

read.count <- featcount %>% dplyr::select(all_of(count_cols)) %>% as.matrix()
rownames(read.count) <- featcount[[1]] #Add GENES / names

#------------------------ SET NAMES & INFO ------------------------#
info <- tibble(old = count_cols) |>
  tidyr::separate_wider_delim(old,
                              delim    = "_",
                              names    = c("rep", "Genotype", "Treatment"),
                              too_many = "drop"
                              ) |>
  mutate(genotype_clean = case_when(Genotype == "ABI" ~ "abi5-7",
                                    Genotype == "LOG" ~ "log2-2",
                                    Genotype == "COL" ~ "COL",
                                    TRUE ~ Genotype),
         new = paste(genotype_clean, Treatment, rep, sep = "_"))
colnames(read.count) <- info$new

#------------------------ DESIGN SAMPLE INFO ------------------------#
sample_names <- colnames(read.count)

# Extract genotype (COL, log2-2, abi5-7) / Set factors
group_setup <- stringr::str_extract(sample_names, "^(abi5-7|COL|log2-2)")
Genotype    <- factor(group_setup, levels = c("COL","log2-2","abi5-7"))

# Extract treatment (GM or LEU) / Set factors
Treatment <- stringr::str_extract(sample_names, "(GM|LEU)")
Treatment <- factor(Treatment, levels = c("GM", "LEU"))

# Build sample info
sample_info <- data.frame(row.names = sample_names,
                          Genotype  = Genotype,
                          Treatment = Treatment)
stopifnot(all(rownames(sample_info) == colnames(read.count))) # Safety check

#------------------------ SAVE ------------------------#
## Convert to DF with gene IDs
#read.count <- tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(as.matrix(read.count)), "GeneID")
#raw_counts_df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(raw_counts_df, "GeneID")
```

# 11. DESEQ CONTRASTS
```{r}
#------------------------ CONTRAST HELPER FUNCTION ------------------------#
condition_contrast <- function(dds, g1, t1, g0, t0) {
  X1 <- model.matrix(design(dds),
                     data.frame(Genotype  = factor(g1, levels = levels(colData(dds)$Genotype)),
                                Treatment = factor(t1, levels = levels(colData(dds)$Treatment)) ))

  X0 <- model.matrix(design(dds),
                     data.frame(Genotype  = factor(g0, levels = levels(colData(dds)$Genotype)), 
                                Treatment = factor(t0, levels = levels(colData(dds)$Treatment)) ))

  as.numeric(X1 - X0)
}

#------------------------ RUN RESULTS FUNCTION ------------------------#
run_result <- function(dds, contrast = NULL, coef = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(coef)) {
    return(lfcShrink(dds, coef = coef, type = "apeglm")) }
  results(dds, contrast = contrast, alpha = 0.05)
}


#------------------------ CONTRAST DEFINITIONS ------------------------#
contrasts <- list(
  # LEU response within genotype
  COL_Leu  = condition_contrast(dds, "COL", "LEU", "COL", "GM"),
  log2_Leu = condition_contrast(dds, "log2-2", "LEU", "log2-2", "GM"),
  abi5_Leu = condition_contrast(dds, "abi5-7", "LEU", "abi5-7", "GM"),

  # Genotype differences under LEU
  abi5_vs_COL_LEU  = condition_contrast(dds, "abi5-7", "LEU", "COL", "LEU"),
  log2_vs_COL_LEU  = condition_contrast(dds, "log2-2", "LEU", "COL", "LEU"),
  log2_vs_abi5_LEU = condition_contrast(dds, "log2-2", "LEU", "abi5-7", "LEU") )

#------------------------ RUN ALL ANALYSES ------------------------#
results_list <- lapply(contrasts, 
                       function(x) run_result(dds, contrast = x) )

#------------------------ ASSIGN INDIVIDUAL OBJECTS ------------------------#
res_COL_Leu          <- results_list$COL_Leu
res_log2_Leu         <- results_list$log2_Leu
res_abi5_Leu         <- results_list$abi5_Leu

res_abi5_vs_COL_LEU  <- results_list$abi5_vs_COL_LEU
res_log2_vs_COL_LEU  <- results_list$log2_vs_COL_LEU
res_log2_vs_abi5_LEU <- results_list$log2_vs_abi5_LEU
```
#  VOLCANO
```{r VOLCANO}
#------------------------ VOLCANO ------------------------#
plot_volcano <- function(res, title){ 
  df <- as.data.frame(res)
  df$status <- "NS"

  df$status[ !is.na(df$padj) & 
               df$padj < 0.05 &
               df$log2FoldChange > 1 ] <- "Up"

  df$status[ !is.na(df$padj) & 
               df$padj < 0.05 &
               df$log2FoldChange < -1 ] <- "Down"

  ggplot(df, aes(log2FoldChange, pvalue) ) +
    geom_point(aes(color = status), alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Up" = "red",
                                  "Down" = "blue",
                                  "NS" = "grey70") ) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = title)
}

#------------------------ PLOTTING & SAVE ------------------------#
v1 <- plot_volcano( res_COL_Leu, "COL: Leu vs GM")
v1
```

#  COMPLETE HEATMAP ALL
```{r Heatmap ALL}
#------------------------ ANNOTATION ------------------------#
# SET ANNOTATIONS
ann_col <- as.data.frame(colData(dds)[, c("Genotype", "Treatment")])
ann_colors <- list(Genotype = genotype_colors,
                   Treatment = treatment_colors,
                   Cluster = cluster_colors)

#------------------------ HEATMAP HELPERS ------------------------#
# SET SIG GENES / Function
get_sig_genes <- function(res,
                          padj_cutoff = pad,
                          lfc_cutoff  = lfc_thresh) {
  
  res_df <- as.data.frame(res)

  res_df %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    filter(!is.na(padj), 
           padj < padj_cutoff, 
           abs(log2FoldChange) > lfc_cutoff) %>%
    pull(gene)
}

prepare_heatmap_matrix <- function(expr_mat, genes) {
  genes <- intersect(genes, rownames(expr_mat))
  
  hm <- expr_mat[genes, , drop = FALSE]
  hm <- hm[apply(hm, 1, sd) > 0, , drop = FALSE] # Rmve invariant genes
  
  hm <- t(scale(t(hm))) # Row z-score
  hm[complete.cases(hm), , drop = FALSE]
  }

#------------------------ HEATMAP FUNCTION ------------------------#
plot_heatmap <- function(res,
                         expr_mat,
                         annotation_col,
                         title,
                         Treatment = NULL) {
  genes <- get_sig_genes(res)
  
  if (length(genes) < 2) {
    message("Not enough significant genes for ", title)
    return(NULL)
  }
  
    if(!is.null(Treatment)) {

    keep <- annotation_col$Treatment == Treatment

    expr_mat <- expr_mat[, keep, drop = FALSE]
    annotation_col <- annotation_col[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  
  hm <- prepare_heatmap_matrix(expr_mat, genes)
  
  pheatmap(hm,
           annotation_col = annotation_col,
           show_rownames = FALSE,
           angle_col = 45,
           color = heat_colors, 
           main = title)
}
#------------------------ HEATMAP PLOTTING ------------------------#
H1 <- plot_heatmap(res_COL_Leu, mat, ann_col, "LEU vs GM")
H2 <- plot_heatmap(res_log2_Leu, mat, ann_col, "log2-2: LEU vs GM")
H3 <- plot_heatmap(res_abi5_Leu, mat, ann_col, "abi5-7: LEU vs GM")

H1_1 <- plot_heatmap(res_COL_Leu, mat, ann_col, "COL-responsive genes (LEU samples)", Treatment = "LEU")
H2_1 <- plot_heatmap(res_log2_Leu, mat, ann_col, "log2-2 responsive genes (LEU samples)", Treatment = "LEU")
H3_1 <- plot_heatmap(res_abi5_Leu, mat, ann_col, "abi5-7 responsive genes (LEU samples)", Treatment = "LEU")
```

# 18. K MEANS CLUSTERING - LEU ONLY
```{r Best K}
#------------------------ KMEANS ANALYSIS ------------------------#
# Elbow Method + Silhouette Analysis
genes <- get_sig_genes(res_COL_Leu)

keep  <- ann_col$Treatment == "LEU" # LEU samples only
ann_sub <- ann_col[keep, , drop = FALSE]

# Scaled heatmap matrix
hm <- prepare_heatmap_matrix(expr_mat = mat[, keep, drop = FALSE], genes = genes)
cat("Genes retained:", nrow(hm), "\n")

# Optimal K
k_range <- 2:15

d <- dist(hm)

wcss <- numeric(length(k_range))
silhouette_avg <- numeric(length(k_range))

set.seed(123)
for(i in seq_along(k_range)) { k <- k_range[i]
km <- kmeans(hm, centers = k, nstart = 50)

wcss[i] <- km$tot.withinss  # Elbow Method

sil <- silhouette(km$cluster, d)  # Silhouette Method
silhouette_avg[i] <- mean(sil[ , 3])
}

# Elbow Plot
elbow_plot <- ggplot(data.frame(k = k_range, WCSS = wcss), aes(k, WCSS)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Elbow Method",
       x = "Number of Clusters (k)",
       y = "Within-Cluster Sum of Squares")

# Silhouette Plot
sil_plot <- ggplot(data.frame(k = k_range, silhouette = silhouette_avg), aes(k, silhouette)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Silhouette Analysis",
       x = "Number of Clusters (k)",
       y = "Average Silhouette Width")

# Display plots side-by-side
grid.arrange(elbow_plot,sil_plot, ncol = 2)
#ggsave( file.path(graphics_dir,"01_1_Kmeans.png"), sidebyside, width = 10, height = 8)

# Recommended k from silhouette
best_k <- k_range[which.max(silhouette_avg)]
cat("\nOptimal k based on silhouette score =", best_k, "\n")
```

```{r Averaged CLUSTERINGS}
#------------------------ LEU GENOTYPE AVERAGED KMEANS HTMAP------------------------#
plot_LEU_kmeans_heatmap <- function(res,
                                    expr_mat,
                                    annotation_col,
                                    title,
                                    padj_cutoff = pad,
                                    lfc_cutoff = lfc_thresh,
                                    k = 5 ) { 
# GET SIGNIFICANT GENES
  genes <- get_sig_genes(res, padj_cutoff = padj_cutoff, lfc_cutoff = lfc_cutoff)

  if (length(genes) < k) {message("Not enough significant genes for ", title)
    return(NULL)
  }

# KEEP LEU SAMPLES ONLY
  keep <- annotation_col$Treatment == "LEU"
  ann  <- annotation_col[keep, , drop = FALSE]

  hm   <- prepare_heatmap_matrix(expr_mat = expr_mat[ , keep, drop = FALSE], genes = genes) #EXPRESSION MATRIX
  
#------------------------ SAFETY CHECK------------------------#
  if(nrow(hm) < k) {
    stop("Number of genes is smaller than k.")
  }

  if(any(is.na(hm))) {
    stop("NA values detected in heatmap matrix.")
  }
  
#------------------------ Metadata------------------------#
  sig_df <- as.data.frame(res)
  sig_df <- sig_df[rownames(hm), , drop = FALSE]

# FORCE GENOTYPE ORDER
  genotype_order <- c("COL", "abi5-7", "log2-2")
  genotype_order <- genotype_order[genotype_order %in% unique(as.character(ann$Genotype)) ]
  
# GENOTYPE MEANS
  hm_avg <- do.call(cbind, lapply(genotype_order,
                                  function(g) {rowMeans(hm[ , ann$Genotype == g, drop = FALSE ], na.rm = TRUE) } ) )
  
  colnames(hm_avg) <- genotype_order
  rownames(hm_avg) <- rownames(hm)
  cat("hm_avg dimensions:", dim(hm_avg), "\n" )

# Z-SCORE BY GENE
  hm_avg <- t(scale(t(hm_avg)))
  hm_avg <- hm_avg[apply(hm_avg, 1, function(x) all(is.finite(x))), , drop = FALSE]

sig_df <- as.data.frame(res)
sig_df <- sig_df[rownames(hm_avg), , drop = FALSE]

#------------------------ K-MEANS------------------------#
  set.seed(123)
  km <- kmeans(hm_avg, centers = k, nstart = 100)
  print(table(km$cluster)) # see genes in clusters

# ORDER GENES BY CLUSTER
  ord <- order(km$cluster)

  row_ann <- data.frame(Cluster = factor(km$cluster))
  rownames(row_ann) <- rownames(hm_avg)
 
gaps_row <- cumsum(table(km$cluster))
gaps_row <- gaps_row[-length(gaps_row)]

# HEATMAP OF AV EXPRESSION
  ph <- pheatmap(hm_avg[ord, ], 
                 annotation_row = row_ann[ord, , drop = FALSE ],
                 annotation_colors = ann_colors,
                 cluster_rows = FALSE,
                 cluster_cols = FALSE,
                 show_rownames = FALSE,
                 show_colnames = TRUE,
                 annotation_names_row = FALSE,
                 gaps_row = gaps_row,
                 main = paste0(title, "(k = ", k, ") "),
                 angle_col = 45,
                 color = heat_colors)

#------------------------ CLUSTER TABLE------------------------#
cluster_df <- data.frame(gene = rownames(hm_avg), cluster = km$cluster)
res_df     <- as.data.frame(res) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("gene")
cluster_df <- left_join(cluster_df, res_df, by = "gene")
  
# RETURN
  list(plot          = ph, 
       hm_avg        = hm_avg,
       kmeans        = km,
       clusters      = cluster_df, 
       cluster_sizes = table(km$cluster))
}

H_clusters <- plot_LEU_kmeans_heatmap(res            = res_COL_Leu, 
                                      expr_mat       = mat, 
                                      annotation_col = ann_col,
                                      title = "LEU-responsive genes",
                                      k = 5)

#------------------------ SAVE------------------------#
#ggsave(file.path(graphics_dir,"cluster_leu_heatmap.png"), H_clusters$plot$gtable, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

cluster_sheets <- split(H_clusters$clusters, 
                        H_clusters$clusters$cluster)

names(cluster_sheets) <- paste0("Cluster_", names(cluster_sheets))

head(H_clusters)
```

```{r}
#------------------------ GO ENRICHMENT ------------------------#
cluster_df <- H_clusters$clusters
clusters <- sort(unique(cluster_df$cluster))

GO_results <- list()

for (cl in clusters) { message("Processing Cluster ", cl)
#------------------------ SPLIT UP / DOWN ------------------------#
  up_genes <- cluster_df %>% 
   filter(cluster == cl, log2FoldChange > 0) %>%
   pull(gene) 
  
 down_genes <- cluster_df %>% 
   filter(cluster == cl, log2FoldChange < 0) %>%
   pull(gene)
 
 cat("Cluster", cl, 
     ": UP =", length(up_genes),
     "DOWN =", length(down_genes),
     "\n")
 
#------------------------ RUN GO ------------------------#
  # UPREGULATED
  if (length(up_genes) > 10) {

    ego_up <- enrichGO(gene = up_genes, 
                       OrgDb = org.At.tair.db,
                       keyType = "TAIR",
                       ont = "BP",
                       pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                       qvalueCutoff = 0.05)
    
    if (nrow(as.data.frame(ego_up)) > 0) { 
      ego_up <- simplify(ego_up, cutoff = 0.7, by = "p.adjust", select_fun = min)
      
      if (nrow(as.data.frame(ego_up)) > 0) {
       ego_up <- pairwise_termsim(ego_up) }
      
      GO_results[[paste0("Cluster", cl, "_UP")]] <- ego_up
      message( "  -> ", nrow(as.data.frame(ego_up)), " enriched UP terms")
    } else { message("  -> No enriched GO terms for UP genes")
    }
    }

  # DOWNREGULATED
  if (length(down_genes) > 10) {

    ego_down <- enrichGO(gene = down_genes,
                         OrgDb = org.At.tair.db,
                         keyType = "TAIR",
                         ont = "BP",
                         pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                         qvalueCutoff = 0.05)
    
    if (nrow(as.data.frame(ego_down)) > 0) { 
      ego_down <- simplify(ego_down, cutoff = 0.7, by = "p.adjust", select_fun = min) 
      if
      (nrow(as.data.frame(ego_down)) > 0) {
        ego_down <- pairwise_termsim(ego_down) }    
      
      GO_results[[paste0("Cluster", cl, "_DOWN")]] <- ego_down 
      message("  -> ", nrow(as.data.frame(ego_down)), " enriched DOWN terms")
      
    } else { message("  -> No enriched GO terms for DOWN genes")
        }
  }
}

#------------------------ SUMMARY ------------------------#
names(GO_results)

sapply(GO_results, function(x) nrow(as.data.frame(x)))
lapply(GO_results, function(x) head(as.data.frame(x)))

#------------------------ SAVE ------------------------#
GO_sheets <- lapply(GO_results, as.data.frame)
```

```{r}
# GO annotations
go_info <- AnnotationDbi::select(org.At.tair.db,
                                 keys = genes,
                                 keytype = "TAIR",
                                 columns = c("GO", "ONTOLOGY")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(GO))

# GO term descriptions
go_terms <- AnnotationDbi::select(GO.db, 
                                  keys = unique(go_info$GO), 
                                  keytype = "GOID",
                                  columns = c("GOID", "TERM"))

go_info <- go_info %>% left_join(go_terms, by = c("GO" = "GOID"))

# collapse GO terms to one row per gene
go_info_summary <- go_info %>%
  mutate(GO_entry = paste0(GO, " (", TERM, ")")) %>%
  group_by(TAIR) %>%
  summarise(GO_terms = paste(unique(GO_entry), collapse = "; "),
            Biological_Process = paste(unique(TERM[ONTOLOGY == "BP"]), collapse = "; "),
            Molecular_Function = paste(unique(TERM[ONTOLOGY == "MF"]), collapse = "; "),
            Cellular_Component = paste(unique(TERM[ONTOLOGY == "CC"]), collapse = "; "), .groups = "drop") %>% rename(GeneID = TAIR)
```

# ABI LEU VS COL LEU
```{r}
#------------------------ DIVERGENT RESPONSES COL & ABI LEU ------------------------#
# Compare the LEU response in COL with the LEU response in abi5.

#------------------------ BUILD COMPARISON TABLE ------------------------#
COL <- as.data.frame(res_COL_Leu)
abi5 <- as.data.frame(res_abi5_Leu)

COL$gene <- rownames(COL)
abi5$gene <- rownames(abi5)

compare_all <- merge(COL, abi5, by = "gene", suffixes = c("_COL", "_abi5"))

compare_all <- compare_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(log2FoldChange_COL), 
         !is.na(log2FoldChange_abi5) )

#------------------------ ADD CLUSTER INFO ------------------------#
# Add previous k-means cluster assignments
compare_df <- compare_all %>% left_join( clust_df[ , c("gene", "cluster")], by = "gene" )

#------------------------ RESPONSE CLASSIFICATION ------------------------#
# Define significant "responding genes" before identifying divergent responses.
compare_df <- compare_df %>% mutate(COL_sig = padj_COL < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange_COL) > 1.5,
                                     abi5_sig = padj_abi5 < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange_abi5) > 1.5,
                                   
                                     deltaFC = log2FoldChange_abi5 - log2FoldChange_COL,
                                    Divergent = !is.na(cluster) & abs(deltaFC) >= 1.5 & 
                                      (COL_sig | abi5_sig),
                                    Opposite = !is.na(cluster) & COL_sig & abi5_sig & 
                                      sign(log2FoldChange_COL) != sign(log2FoldChange_abi5))

#------------------------ CORRELATION ------------------------#
cor_val <- cor(compare_df$log2FoldChange_COL,
               compare_df$log2FoldChange_abi5,
               use = "complete.obs")
cat("Correlation =", round(cor_val, 3), "\n")

#------------------------ EXTRACT GENE SETS ------------------------#
divergent_genes <- compare_df %>% filter(Divergent) %>% arrange(desc(abs(deltaFC)))
opposite_response <- compare_df %>% filter(Opposite) %>% arrange(desc(abs(deltaFC)))

cat("Divergent genes:", nrow(divergent_genes), "\n")
cat("Opposite response genes:", nrow(opposite_response), "\n")

#------------------------ CLUSTER SUMMARY ------------------------#
# Which expression clusters contribute most to the genotype-specific LEU response?
cluster_summary <- divergent_genes %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(n_genes = n(),
            mean_deltaFC = mean(abs(deltaFC)),
            median_deltaFC = median(abs(deltaFC)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_genes))
#------------------------ SCATTERPLOT ------------------------#
top_labels <- divergent_genes %>% slice_max(order_by = abs(deltaFC), n = 20)

p_compare <- ggplot() +
  # all genes
  geom_point(data = compare_df,
             aes(x = log2FoldChange_COL,
                 y = log2FoldChange_abi5),
             color = "grey80",
             alpha = 0.25,
             size = 1 ) +

# highlighted divergent genes
  geom_point(data = divergent_genes,
             aes(x = log2FoldChange_COL,
                 y = log2FoldChange_abi5,
                 color = factor(cluster) ),
             size = 2.5) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 2) +

  geom_text_repel(data = top_labels,
                  aes(x = log2FoldChange_COL,
                      y = log2FoldChange_abi5,
                      label = gene ),
                  size = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
labs(title = paste0("COL vs abi5 LEU Response (r = ", round(cor_val, 3), ")" ),
     x = "COL LEU response log2FC",
     y = "abi5 LEU response log2FC",
     color = "Cluster")
p_compare

#ggsave(file.path( graphics_dir, "COL_abi5_divergent_genes.png"),
#        p_compare,
#        width = 8,
#        height = 6,
#        dpi = 300)


#------------------------ GENOTYPE DIFFERENCES ON LEU ------------------------#
# Purpose:
```

```{r}
#------------------------ DIVERGENT RESPONSES LOG2 COL & LEU ------------------------#
# BUILD COMPARISON TABLE 
COL <- as.data.frame(res_COL_Leu)
log2 <- as.data.frame(res_log2_Leu)

COL$gene <- rownames(COL)
log2$gene <- rownames(log2)

compare_all <- merge(COL, log2, by = "gene", suffixes = c("_COL", "_log2"))

compare_all <- compare_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(log2FoldChange_COL), 
         !is.na(log2FoldChange_log2) )

# ADD CLUSTER INFO       #
compare_df <- compare_all %>% left_join(clust_df[, c("gene", "cluster")], by = "gene" )

compare_df <- compare_df %>%
  mutate(COL_sig = padj_COL < 0.05 &
           abs(log2FoldChange_COL) > 1.5,
         log2_sig = padj_log2 < 0.05 &
           abs(log2FoldChange_log2) > 1.5,
         
         deltaFC = log2FoldChange_log2 - log2FoldChange_COL,
         
         Divergent = !is.na(cluster) &
           abs(deltaFC) >= 1.5 &
           (COL_sig | log2_sig),
         
         Opposite = !is.na(cluster) &
           COL_sig &
           log2_sig &
           sign(log2FoldChange_COL) != sign(log2FoldChange_log2))

# CORRELATION
cor_val <- cor(compare_df$log2FoldChange_COL,
               compare_df$log2FoldChange_log2,
               use = "complete.obs")
cat("Correlation =", round(cor_val, 3), "\n")

# DIVERGENT GENES
divergent_genes <- compare_df %>%
  filter(Divergent) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(deltaFC)))

# OPPOSITE RESPONSE
opposite_response <- compare_df %>%
  filter(Opposite) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(deltaFC)))
cat("Opposite response genes:", nrow(opposite_response), "\n")

# CLUSTER SUMMARY        
cluster_summary <- divergent_genes %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(n_genes = n(),
            mean_deltaFC = mean(abs(deltaFC)),
            median_deltaFC = median(abs(deltaFC)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_genes))

# SCATTERPLOT
top_labels <- divergent_genes %>%
  slice_max(order_by = abs(deltaFC), n = 20)

p_compare <- ggplot() +
  # all genes
  geom_point(data = compare_df,
             aes(x = log2FoldChange_COL,
                 y = log2FoldChange_log2),
             color = "grey80",
             alpha = 0.25,
             size = 1 ) +

  # clustered divergent genes
  geom_point(data = divergent_genes,
             aes(x = log2FoldChange_COL,
                 y = log2FoldChange_log2,
                 color = factor(cluster) ),
             size = 2.5) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 2) +

  geom_text_repel(data = top_labels,
                  aes(x = log2FoldChange_COL,
                      y = log2FoldChange_log2,
                      label = gene ),
                  size = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
labs(title = paste0("COL vs abi5 LEU Response (r = ", round(cor_val, 3), ")" ),
     x = "COL LEU response log2FC",
     y = "log2 LEU response log2FC",
     color = "Cluster")
p_compare

#ggsave(file.path( graphics_dir, "COL_log2_divergent_genes.png"),
#        p_compare,
#        width = 8,
#        height = 6,
#        dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
#------------------------ GENOTYPE COMPARISON ON LEU ------------------------#
sig_log2_vs_abi5      <- as.data.frame(res_log2_vs_abi5_LEU)
sig_log2_vs_abi5$gene <- rownames(sig_log2_vs_abi5)
sig_log2_vs_abi5      <- sig_log2_vs_abi5 %>% filter(!is.na(padj), 
                                                     padj < 0.05, 
                                                     abs(log2FoldChange) > 1.5)
cat("Directly different genes (log2 vs abi5 under LEU):", nrow(sig_log2_vs_abi5), "\n")

#------------------------ RESPONSE COMPARISON TABLE ------------------------#
abi5 <- as.data.frame(res_abi5_Leu) # abi5 LEU vs GM 
log2 <- as.data.frame(res_log2_Leu) # log2 LEU vs GM
abi5$gene <- rownames(abi5)
log2$gene <- rownames(log2)

compare_df <- merge(abi5, log2, by = "gene", suffixes = c("_abi5", "_log2"))
compare_df <- compare_df %>% filter(!is.na(log2FoldChange_abi5), 
                                    !is.na(log2FoldChange_log2))
#------------------------ CORR ------------------------#
cor_val <- cor(compare_df$log2FoldChange_abi5, 
               compare_df$log2FoldChange_log2, 
               use = "complete.obs")
cat("Correlation =", round(cor_val, 3), "\n")

#------------------------ CLUSTERS & DIRECT COMPARISON FLAG ------------------------#
compare_df <- compare_df %>% left_join(clust_df[ , c("gene", "cluster")], by = "gene" )
compare_df_clusters <- compare_df %>% filter(!is.na(cluster))
compare_df <- compare_df %>% mutate(direct_sig = gene %in% sig_log2_vs_abi5$gene)

#------------------------ RESPONSE DIFFERENCE CALCULATIONS ------------------------#
compare_df <- compare_df %>% mutate(abi5_sig = !is.na(padj_abi5) & 
                                      padj_abi5 < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange_abi5) > 1.5,
                                    log2_sig = !is.na(padj_log2) &
                                      padj_log2 < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange_log2) > 1.5,
                                    
                                    deltaFC = log2FoldChange_log2 - log2FoldChange_abi5,
                                    Category = case_when(abi5_sig & log2_sig ~ "Shared",
                                                         log2_sig & !abi5_sig ~ "log2_specific",
                                                         abi5_sig & !log2_sig ~ "abi5_specific",
                                                         TRUE ~ "Not_sig"),
                                    Relation = case_when(abi5_sig & log2_sig & 
                                                           sign(log2FoldChange_abi5) == sign(log2FoldChange_log2) ~ "Same_direction",
                                                         abi5_sig & log2_sig & 
                                                           sign(log2FoldChange_abi5) != sign(log2FoldChange_log2) ~ "Opposite", 
                                                         log2_sig & !abi5_sig ~ "log2_unique",
                                                         abi5_sig & !log2_sig ~ "abi5_unique",
                                                         TRUE ~ "Other"))

#------------------------ GENE SETS ------------------------#
shared_genes    <- compare_df %>% filter(Category == "Shared")
log2_specific   <- compare_df %>% filter(Category == "log2_specific")
abi5_specific   <- compare_df %>% filter(Category == "abi5_specific")
divergent_genes <- compare_df %>% filter(abs(deltaFC) >= 1.5 &
                                           (abi5_sig | log2_sig)) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(deltaFC)))
cat("Divergent genes:", nrow(divergent_genes), "\n")

opposite_response <- compare_df %>% filter(abi5_sig & log2_sig &
                                             sign(log2FoldChange_abi5) != sign(log2FoldChange_log2)) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(deltaFC)))
cat("Opposite response genes:", nrow(opposite_response), "\n")

#------------------------ STRONGEST PHENOTYPE CANDIDATES ------------------------#
best_candidates <- compare_df %>% filter(direct_sig, abs(deltaFC) >= 1.5) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(deltaFC)))
cat("Best candidate genes:", nrow(best_candidates), "\n")

#------------------------ CLUSTER SUMMARIES ------------------------#
cluster_summary <- divergent_genes %>% group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(n_genes = n(), mean_deltaFC = mean(abs(deltaFC)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_genes))
print(cluster_summary)

log2_cluster_summary <- log2_specific %>% 
  group_by(cluster) %>% 
  summarise(n_genes = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_genes))
print(log2_cluster_summary)

abi5_cluster_summary <- abi5_specific %>% 
  group_by(cluster) %>% 
  summarise(n_genes = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_genes))
print(abi5_cluster_summary)

#------------------------ SCATTERPLOT ------------------------#
top_labels <- divergent_genes %>% slice_max(order_by = abs(deltaFC), n = 20)

p_scatter <- ggplot(compare_df, aes(x = log2FoldChange_abi5,
                                    y = log2FoldChange_log2)) +
  geom_point(color = "grey80", alpha = 0.3, size = 1) +
  geom_point(data = divergent_genes %>% filter(!is.na(cluster)),
             aes(color = factor(cluster)), size = 2.5) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  geom_text_repel(data = top_labels %>% filter(!is.na(cluster)), aes(label = gene), size = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = paste0("abi5 vs log2 LEU response (r = ", round(cor_val, 3), ")" ), 
       x = "abi5 log2FC",
       y = "log2 log2FC",
       color = "Cluster")
p_scatter
#ggsave(file.path( graphics_dir, "COL_log2_divergent_genes.png"),
#        p_compare,
#        width = 8,
#        height = 6,
#        dpi = 300)

#------------------------ CATEGORY PLOT ------------------------#
p_category <- ggplot(compare_df, aes(x = log2FoldChange_abi5,
                                     y = log2FoldChange_log2)) +
  geom_point(data = subset(compare_df, Category == "Not_sig"),
             color = "grey85", alpha = 0.2, size = 1) +
  geom_point(data = subset(compare_df, Category != "Not_sig"),
             aes(color = Category),
             alpha = 0.8, size = 1.5) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Shared" = "#1b9e77",
                                "log2_specific" = "#d95f02",
                                "abi5_specific" = "#7570b3")) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Gene response categories",
       x = "abi5 log2FC",

p_category
```
